title: Buses Between Cities
statementMd:
Buses run between the cities $*A*$ and $*B*$, the first one is at 05:00 AM and the last one departs not later than at 11:59 PM. A bus from the city $*A*$ departs every $*a*$ minutes and arrives to the city $*B*$ in a $*t*_{*a*}$ minutes, and a bus from the city $*B*$ departs every $*b*$ minutes and arrives to the city $*A*$ in a $*t*_{*b*}$ minutes.

The driver Simion wants to make his job diverse, so he counts the buses going towards him. Simion doesn't count the buses he meet at the start and finish.

You know the time when Simion departed from the city $*A*$ to the city $*B*$. Calculate the number of buses Simion will meet to be sure in his counting.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*a*, *t*_{*a*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *t*_{*a*} ≤ 120$) — the frequency of the buses from the city $*A*$ to the city $*B*$ and the travel time. Both values are given in minutes.

The second line contains two integers $*b*, *t*_{*b*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*, *t*_{*b*} ≤ 120$) — the frequency of the buses from the city $*B*$ to the city $*A*$ and the travel time. Both values are given in minutes.

The last line contains the departure time of Simion from the city $*A*$ in the format `hh:mm`. It is guaranteed that there are a bus from the city $*A*$ at that time. Note that the hours and the minutes are given with exactly two digits.

## Output

Print the only integer $*z*$ — the number of buses Simion will meet on the way. Note that you should not count the encounters in cities $*A*$ and $*B*$.

## Note

In the first example Simion departs form the city $*A*$ at 05:20 AM and arrives to the city $*B*$ at 05:50 AM. He will meet the first $5$ buses from the city $*B*$ that departed in the period [05:00 AM - 05:40 AM]. Also Simion will meet a bus in the city $*B*$ at 05:50 AM, but he will not count it.

Also note that the first encounter will be between 05:26 AM and 05:27 AM (if we suggest that the buses are go with the sustained speed).
statementZhMd:
公交车在城市 $*A*$ 和 $*B*$ 之间运行，首班车在 05:00 AM 发车，末班车的发车时间不晚于 11:59 PM。从城市 $*A*$ 出发的公交车每隔 $*a*$ 分钟发车，并在 $*t*_{*a*}$ 分钟后到达城市 $*B*$；从城市 $*B*$ 出发的公交车每隔 $*b*$ 分钟发车，并在 $*t*_{*b*}$ 分钟后到达城市 $*A*$。

司机 Simion 希望让自己的工作更加多样化，因此他会数经过他的公交车。Simion 不会数在起点和终点遇到的公交车。

你知道 Simion 从城市 $*A*$ 出发前往城市 $*B*$ 的时间。请计算 Simion 为了确保计数准确，在途中会遇到多少辆公交车。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*a*, *t*_{*a*}$（$1 ≤ *a*, *t*_{*a*} ≤ 120$）——从城市 $*A*$ 到城市 $*B*$ 的公交车发车间隔和行驶时间。两个数值均以分钟为单位给出。

第二行包含两个整数 $*b*, *t*_{*b*}$（$1 ≤ *b*, *t*_{*b*} ≤ 120$）——从城市 $*B*$ 到城市 $*A*$ 的公交车发车间隔和行驶时间。两个数值均以分钟为单位给出。

最后一行包含 Simion 从城市 $*A*$ 出发的时间，格式为 `hh:mm`。保证在该时间有一辆公交车从城市 $*A*$ 发车。注意，小时和分钟都恰好由两位数字表示。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数 $*z*$——Simion 在途中会遇到的公交车数量。注意，不应计算在城市 $*A*$ 和 $*B*$ 中发生的相遇。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Simion 于 05:20 AM 从城市 $*A*$ 出发，并于 05:50 AM 到达城市 $*B*$。他会遇到从城市 $*B*$ 出发、发车时间处于 [05:00 AM - 05:40 AM] 期间的前 $5$ 辆公交车。他还会在 05:50 AM 于城市 $*B*$ 遇到一辆公交车，但不会将其计入。

另外请注意，第一次相遇将发生在 05:26 AM 和 05:27 AM 之间（假设公交车以匀速行驶）。
